strings.meta.title: pdff — Hlanganisa, guqulela futhi uhlele i-PDF, i-Word, i-Excel mahhala
strings.meta.description: Ithuluzi lamahhala le-inthanethi lokuhlanganisa, ukuguqula, ukucindezela, ukwahlukanisa nokuvikela amafayela akho e-PDF, i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint kanye nezithombe. Akukho ukubhalisa, amafayela asuswa ngokushesha.
strings.meta.keywords: hlanganisa i-pdf, guqulela i-pdf, i-pdf ibe i-word, i-word ibe i-pdf, jpg ibe i-pdf, i-pdf ibe i-jpg, cindezela i-pdf, hlukanisa i-pdf, i-excel ibe i-pdf, amathuluzi amahhala e-pdf
strings.footer.text: Mahhala, akukho ukubhalisa. Amafayela akho asuswa kwenziwa nje ukucubungula.
strings.home.title: Wonke amadokhumenti akho, ethuluzini elilodwa.
strings.home.subtitle: I-PDF, i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, izithombe: hlanganisa, guqulela futhi uhlele ngemizuzwana.
strings.home.trust: Mahhala, akukho ukubhalisa, akukho uphawu lwangemuva olungeziwe.
strings.home.orbitHint: Bamba isithonjana, ujikelezise indandatho, thinta ishidi lasekhaya.
strings.home.formatsSubtitle: Lawo ahamba ngempela phakathi kwamahhovisi, izikole namabhizinisi.
strings.home.steps[0].title: Phonsa
strings.home.steps[0].text: Hudulela amafayela akho phakathi noma uwakhethe ocingweni lwakho.
strings.home.steps[1].title: Khetha
strings.home.steps[1].text: Beka ukulandelana, ifomethi yokuphuma noma amakhasi ozowagcina.
strings.home.steps[2].title: Landa
strings.notice.officeMissingText: Faka i-LibreOffice (mahhala) ukuze uwavule, bese uqala kabusha i-pdff. Ku-Windows:
strings.workspace.dropAny: I-PDF, i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, izithombe, i-EPUB, umbhalo…
strings.workspace.approximate: Kusuka ku-PDF, ukwakheka kuyabuyiselwa: umphumela ungase udinge ukulungiswa, ikakhulukazi kudokhumenti enama-scan.
strings.workspace.targetEmpty: Engeza ifayela ukuze ubone amafomethi atholakalayo.

strings.language.unavailable: Ukuhumusha okuzenzakalelayo akukavulwa kule seva: i-pdff iboniswa ngesiNgisi.
strings.language.failed: Ukuhumushela ku-{lang} kwehlulekile. Sicela uzame futhi kamuva.
strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% mahhala
strings.seo.why[0].text: Akukho okubhaliselwe, akukho ikhadi lesikweletu, akukho uphawu lwangemuva olungeziwe emadokhumentini akho.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Akukho ukubhalisa
strings.seo.why[1].text: Akukho akhawunti okumele uyidale: vula ikhasi, phonsa amafayela akho, kwenziwe.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Amafayela akho ahlala awakho
strings.seo.why[2].text: Acutshungulwe, bese asuswa ngokushesha. Asigcini madokhumenti akho noma idatha yakho.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Wonke amafomethi
strings.seo.why[3].text: I-PDF, i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, i-OpenDocument, izithombe, i-EPUB… kusuka kukhompyutha noma ocingweni.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Yebo. Wonke amathuluzi amahhala, alandela ngaphandle kophawu lwangemuva futhi akukho lutho olukhiyelwe ngaphansi kokubhalisele. Alikho ikhadi lesikweletu elicelwayo.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Cha. Akukho ukubhalisa, akukho kheli le-imeyili: usebenzisa amathuluzi ngokushesha.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Cha. Amafayela akho asetshenziselwa umsebenzi owucele kuphela, bese asuswa. Akekho owafundayo futhi awabelwane neze.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Yebo. I-pdff isebenza kusiphequluli sanoma yiluphi ucingo, ithebhulethi noma ikhompyutha (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), futhi akukho okufanele kufakwe.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: I-PDF, i-Word (DOCX, DOC), i-Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), i-PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), i-OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), i-RTF, izithombe (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), i-EPUB, i-TXT, i-HTML nokunye okuningi.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Ungacubungula amafayela angu-{files} ngesikhathi esisodwa, futhi idokhumenti ekhiqiziwe ingaba namakhasi afika kwangu-{pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Ubumfihlo
strings.privacy.description: Indlela i-pdff ephatha ngayo amafayela akho: akukho akhawunti, akukho dokhumenti elondoloziwe, akukho zikhangiso futhi akukho ukuthengiswa kwedatha.
strings.privacy.intro: I-pdff yakhelwe ukuze amadokhumenti akho ahlale awakho. Nakhu, ngamagama acacile, okwenzekayo uma uyisebenzisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Amafayela akho
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Athunyelwa ebethelwe (HTTPS), acutshungulwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, bese asuswa ngokushesha nje lapho umphumela usulungele. Amafayela amakhulu adlula kwisitoreji sesikhashana ngaphansi kwegama elingahleliwe futhi asulwe ngokushesha nje lapho ukucubungula kuphela; ukuhlanzwa okuzenzakalelayo kususa noma yini engase isale kungakapheli amahora angu-24 kakhulu.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Akukho akhawunti, ayikho idatha yomuntu siqu
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: I-pdff ayiceli ukubhalisa, ikheli le-imeyili noma ikhadi lesikweletu. Amadokhumenti akho awafundwa, ahlaziywa, abelwane noma asetshenziselwe ukuqeqesha ubuchopho bokuzenzela.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Ukulinganiswa kwezivakashi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Sibala izivakashi ngaphandle kokwaziwa nokungena amakhukhi (Vercel Web Analytics) ukuze sifunde ukuthi yimaphi amathuluzi awusizo. Azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela kuzo zonke izingosi.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Amakhukhi
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Ikhukhi elilodwa, elingazikhethela: likhumbula ulimi olukhethile.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Ukusingatha
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Isiza singanyatheliswa yi-Vercel kumaseva aseParis; ukuguqulwa kwe-Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint kuphathwa yi-Render eFrankfurt. Laba abahlinzeki baphethe amafayela kuphela ngesikhathi sokuguqula.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Xhumana nathi
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Umbuzo noma umbono? Xhumana nathi ekhasini lephrojekthi:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Hlanganisa
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Hlanganisa amafayela amaningi (PDF, Word, izithombe…) abe yi-PDF eyodwa, ngendlela oyikhethile.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Hlanganisa amafayela e-PDF ku-inthanethi mahhala (Word, izithombe, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Hlanganisa i-PDF, i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint kanye namafayela ezithombe abe yi-PDF eyodwa, ngendlela oyifunayo. Mahhala, akukho ukubhalisa, akukho uphawu lwangemuva, amafayela asuswa ngokushesha.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Faka wonke amaphepha akho kufayela elilodwa: i-pdff ithatha ama-PDF kodwa futhi namadokhumenti e-Word, amashidi e-Excel, izethulo nezithombe, futhi ihlanganise ibe yi-PDF ehlanzekile enebhukhimakhi ngefaayela ngalinye.
strings.tools.fusionner.options.bookmarks.label: Engeza ibhukhimakhi eyodwa ngefayela ngalinye
strings.tools.convertir.name: Guqulela
strings.tools.convertir.tagline: Guqulela noma yiluphi udokhumenti noma isithombe kwelinye ifomethi.
strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Guqulela i-PDF ibe yi-Word, Word ibe yi-PDF, JPG ibe yi-PDF — mahhala
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Isiguquli samahhala: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB namafomethi angaphezu kwangu-40. Ku-inthanethi, akukho ukubhalisa, ikhwalithi ephezulu.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Isiguquli esisodwa sawo wonke amafomethi: Word ibe yi-PDF, PDF ibe yi-Word, JPG ibe yi-PDF, PDF ibe yi-JPG, Excel ibe yi-PDF, PowerPoint ibe yi-PDF, PNG ibe yi-JPG, EPUB ibe yi-PDF… Phonsa amafayela akho futhi i-pdff inikeza kuphela amafomethi angenzeka.

strings.tools.diviser.name: Hlukanisa
strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Hlukanisa i-PDF ibe amafayela amaningi: ngobubanzi bamakhasi noma ikhasi ngelekhasi.
strings.tools.diviser.seoTitle: Hlukanisa i-PDF ku-inthanethi mahhala — amakhasi ahlukile
strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Hlukanisa i-PDF ibe amafayela amaningi: ngobubanzi bamakhasi, ikhasi ngelekhasi noma njalo ngamakhasi angu-N. Mahhala, kuyashesha futhi akukho ukubhalisa.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Thumela ingxenye kuphela yedokhumenti enkulu ebalulekile: i-pdff isika i-PDF yakho ngobubanzi obukhethile futhi ibuyisele izingcezu ku-ZIP archive.

strings.tools.extraire.name: Khipha / susa amakhasi
strings.tools.extraire.tagline: Gcina noma susa amakhasi athile e-PDF.
strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Khipha noma susa amakhasi ku-PDF — mahhala
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Gcina amakhasi owadingayo kuphela ku-PDF, noma susa lawo angeziwe. Ku-inthanethi, mahhala, akukho ukubhalisa, akukho uphawu lwangemuva.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Ikhasi elingenalutho, isijobelelo esingenamsebenzi, ikhasi eliphindaphindiwe? Thayipha amakhasi ozowagcina noma owasuse (isibonelo 1-3, 7, 10-end) bese uthola i-PDF ehlanzekile ngemizuzwana.

strings.tools.extraire.options.pages.label: Amakhasi
strings.tools.organiser.name: Hlela kabusha amakhasi
strings.tools.organiser.seoTitle: Hlela kabusha amakhasi e-PDF ku-inthanethi — mahhala
strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Shintsha ukulandelana kwamakhasi e-PDF, phindaphinda amanye noma guqula yonke idokhumenti. Mahhala, ku-inthanethi, akukho ukubhalisa.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: Amakhasi athathwe nge-scan ngokungalandelani? Thayipha ukulandelana okusha (isibonelo 3, 1, 2, 4-end) noma guqula yonke idokhumenti: i-pdff yenza okunye.

strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Zikelezisa wonke amakhasi e-PDF noma amanye kuphela, ngo-90°, 180° noma 270°. Mahhala, kuyashesha, akukho ukubhalisa.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: I-scan ephendqene phansi noma ikhasi elibheke ngenhla? Zikelezisa yonke idokhumenti noma amakhasi owakhethayo kuphela, ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yikhwalithi.

strings.tools.numeroter.seoDescription: Engeza izinombolo zamakhasi ku-PDF: khetha indawo, ifomethi ethi "1 / 10", inombolo yokuqala nosayizi. Mahhala, akukho ukubhalisa.
strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Ilungele ithesis, ifayela lesicelo noma umbiko: khetha indawo, ifomethi kanye nenombolo yokuqala, futhi i-pdff ibeka izinombolo emakhasini akho kahle.

strings.tools.compresser.seoTitle: Cindezela i-PDF ku-inthanethi — nciphisa usayizi wefayela mahhala
strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Nciphisa i-PDF ukuze uyithumele nge-imeyili noma uyilayishe kuwebhusayithi esemthethweni. Amazinga amathathu wokucindezela, amahhala.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Ingosi yenqaba ifayela lakho ngoba liyasinda kakhulu? Cindezela i-PDF yakho ngenkathi ugcina umbhalo ucacile: khetha okungenakulahlekelwa, okunconyiwe noma okuqinile kuye ngosayizi owudingayo.

strings.tools.proteger.intro: Ngaphambi kokuthumela isiliphu somholo noma udokhumenti wezokwelapha, lihlome ngephasiwedi eqinile: ngaphandle kwayo, akekho ongayivula.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: Uyayazi iphasiwedi, kodwa ukuyitheyipha isikhathi ngasinye kuyinkinga? Yisuse kanye naphakade. I-pdff ayidlulisi iphasiwedi ongayazi.
